scope: Both final full original images actually reopened after freeze 2026-11-01T00:51:32.464Z. Ten low-contrast vector ambient overlays, forty rendered samples; no claim of inspection of complete textured stage backgrounds.

artifacts.observation: Viewed the entire original first page: four time samples for each of Crash warp-room ring, Jim industrial fan, Monkey Island dock cloth, Cuphead brook bridge and Jet Set Radio overhead banner. These are faint line-based ambient overlays on a dark neutral QA background. Moving cloth, fan/ring orientation and surface-line differences are visible. This evidence checks the separate ambient renderer, not a finished textured map or an official 1:1 reproduction.

Viewed the entire original second page: four time samples each for Oddworld conveyor/vent, Dead Rising atrium fan/banner, Parasite Eve curtain/ventilation, Cowboy Bebop service hatch and Wakfu branches/leaves. Their silhouettes and moving details differ by source environment; the images remain low-contrast vector overlays. Full stage backgrounds and playable Tactics terrain are outside these isolated studies.
